hyperedges.label: Research agent fan-out scoring tickers
Score -> decide -> size -> risk -> order flow
LLM agents enforcing citation grounding
Config write loop: dashboard introspects, coerces, validates, hot-swaps
Replay reuses live pipeline code paths against scratch DB
Run lifecycle persistence: models to upserts to schema
Order lifecycle: create -> approve -> route -> fill
Discovery funnel: candidates -> quant screen -> persist/approve
Alpaca sync: retry/poll fill via shared accounting + reconcile drift

hyperedges.description: Kronos model assembles hierarchical token embedding, transformer stack, dependency-aware s1->s2 conditioning, and dual prediction head into the forecasting architecture
Autoregressive inference flow: tokenizer encodes input, model decodes s1/s2 logits, sample_from_logits draws tokens, tokenizer decodes back to price space
Shared synthetic/no-network test fixtures consumed across backtest, discovery, kronos, and fundamentals suites
